road_plane_description: Approximate quadrilateral on a central lane of the left carriageway.

units.speed: km/h for display only (demo; not physically calibrated)

notes: DEMO ONLY. The road polygon is estimated visually from video5.mp4. The 3.6 m lane width and 30 m road length are assumptions, not measurements. Displayed km/h is the estimated m/s multiplied by 3.6; this conversion does not make the result physically accurate. Verify the four road-plane points and measure known distances before using this calibration for real-world speed.
